_comment: Known failures for scripts/verify.py (see its docstring for the matching rules). Every other failure is a
regression. 'flaky': may pass too; 'result': only failures where tlx reported this result kind match.

with several workers, which of the level's two errors (the tableau predicate's \div by 0, the invariant) is found first depends on timing; on main e730267 too (6 of 10 runs report the \div error)
two invariants are violated in the same BFS level: with several workers the one reported depends on the schedule (TLC -workers 8 reports either too)
paranoid mode also evaluates every state in the interpreter: slower than the suite's timeout on a busy machine

SYMMETRY: TLC with several workers reports different distinct counts from run to run (t3_l3: 17,936,089 and 17,936,128; c5: 46,952,133 and 46,952,052) and depth 48 where tlx -workers 16 reports 17,935,823 and depth 47; the multi-worker oracle is no exact reference (a 1-worker TLC run would settle it)
